author: haydock
title: Catholic Family Bible and Commentary: Romans
edition: Haydock's Catholic Family Bible and Commentary, New York: Edward Dunigan and Brother, 1859; text from an archive.org transcription of the notes ("Haydock Catholic Bible Commentary", transcriber not named), djvu OCR text

rights.worldwide: public domain: Haydock died in 1849; the 1859 edition's editors and the transcription's maker are still to identify

notes: The notes follow the Douay-Rheims text and its verse numbers. Haydock gathers other Catholic commentators and marks each note with its source (Wi. Witham, Ch. Challoner; Calmet, Estius and Menochius by name; other letters as he prints them), and the excerpts keep those marks. One excerpt per verse note ("Ver. 1. ...", or a range, "Ver. 19-20. ..."), up to about 350 words and cut at a sentence end; the introduction to the epistle, on no one verse, is not included. The source is the OCR of a typed transcription, not of the 1859 pages. Its Greek is OCR noise and is left out, marked " ... " (Romans 1:3, 1:30, 1:32, 2:17, 2:26, 4:19, 5:20, 15:15, 16:4), as is a damaged reference in the note on 11:11-15; the footnote marks it prints in the text ("[1]", "'21", "|41") are left out. Letters it misreads in Latin words and names ("Irenzus", "Antiochiz", "preeputium", "Pheebe") are kept as they stand: the printed page is still to be checked. This transcription is to be checked against a scan of the 1859 edition.
